newsitem.title: JAPAN: Some Japan bank shares rise in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Some Japan bank shares rise in early morning trade.

text.p: Some bank shares edged higher in early morning Wednesday trade, as moves resumed to buy back the shares which had been battered fiercely in recent weeks, brokers said.
As of 0058 GMT, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd shares were up 10 yen at 2,100 on turnover of 2.42 million shares, the most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Fuji Bank Ltd followed, up 30 yen at 1,600, on turnover of 2.03 million shares.
Sumitomo Bank Ltd added 20 yen to reach 1,650 yen and Sakura Bank Ltd 11 yen to 823 yen.
"Usually buy-back phases only last for two or three days," a "Big Four" broker said.
"But banking sector shares were sold so much it may take a while longer for them to recover."
